title: 官方 Provider 隔离进程与资源限制验证（Windows 外部门禁）
risks: Restricted Token privilege reduction is executed, but same-user file ACLs and loopback network remain reachable; Windows filesystem/network confinement is unproven.

Provider RPC cancel envelope acknowledgement remains unexecuted; forced process-tree termination is not protocol acknowledgement.
Production Worker integration and 500k-asset scheduling/overhead remain out of scope.
